card.name: Leading digit before a decimal point
card.fires_on: The digit just before a decimal point in a number, most often 0, in dosing tables, conversion factors, rates and p-values. It responds to the whole-number part, not to the decimals.

modes.label: Table values
modes.description: A leading 0 or 1 in a table cell of doses, volumes, rates or conversion factors.

modes.label: Statistics
modes.description: A leading digit of a p-value or confidence interval value.

card.plain: It marks the whole-number digit at the start of a decimal number, as in dose tables or p-values.
